scoreContext: Comparative judgments against original and fixed target, with no numeric approval threshold. The source was recognizable but flat and had nearly black support faces; this native candidate materially improves construction, soft volume and intended-size readability.
observations: The native cyan hoop, outer structural rail, framed blue ornaments, saddle connections and two grounded navy supports read as one deliberately constructed portal. N/S retain a generous transparent opening; E/W are useful physical profiles with substantial depth, not a billboard. The improved native geometry serves the frozen identity and role.

Cyan/blue remain the focal palette. Warm gold edge construction separates adjacent teal surfaces and adds restrained craftsmanship, while the lighter navy facets keep lower support volume readable on light, gray and dark. The broad cyan rim rolloff and rounded gold bevels are softer and more legible than the original flat bands; no preferred horizontal key or directional ground shadow appears.

Complete 48-phase native/published sheets and complete 96 actual browser-canvas phase cells were inspected. S003/N009 pulse extrema and E003/W009 profiles were inspected enlarged. The lower blue ornaments circulate through expected occlusion behind the support structure; the saddles and support-to-ring construction remain coherent, without a visible severed connection, coplanar flicker, black patch, clipped ornament or unwanted halo.

At logical and 0.55 phone scale, aperture, rim, blue/gold rhythm and support masses remain distinct. Small ornament bevels simplify naturally at phone size without destroying the larger construction. Both actual headless browser display sets were inspected on light/gray/dark backgrounds.

Both bound playback wrap sheets were inspected alongside original video metadata and full phase files. Independent live replay of the exact bound fixture in full Chromium and headless shell reproduced all phase canvas hashes and showed the sequential raw-frame range 0..26 over at least 2.2 seconds, including two 11-to-0 wraps, without a material pop or support drift.
remainingDifferences: The candidate uses a restrained matte cyan channel and broad turning planes rather than the target’s painted water streaks and luminous surface texture. Those literal streaks were never required and the native volume remains coherent.
The blue inserts are simple beveled panels rather than the target’s faceted jewel cuts; the gold construction is cleaner and less ornate. These differences keep the intended-size hierarchy clear.
The supports retain deliberate planar stone facets and the side views remain naturally edge-on. Neither target-outline matching nor unseen-view imitation was required.
publicationScope: This approval binds only the supplied round-01 packet and editable native source. No additional asset/family/production/integration/deployment approval is implied.
independence: Original independent judge; original raw-first interpretation and three ranked outcomes retained. No editor self-ratings or persuasive rationale were used.
